About Clarkwood MOT

Formerly Riverside MOT Centre — now under new family management

Clarkwood MOT Ltd is a proudly family-owned and family-managed MOT Centre based in Melksham, Wiltshire, specialising exclusively in professional DVSA-approved MOT testing.

"To provide honest, professional MOT testing with exceptional customer service, complete transparency and a welcoming experience for every customer."

Whether you're bringing us your family car, motorcycle, van or business fleet, you'll always receive honest advice, friendly service and professional inspections carried out with integrity.

What sets us apart

  • ✓  Family Owned & Managed
  • ✓  Independent
  • ✓  DVSA Approved
  • ✓  Honest & Transparent Service
  • ✓  Modern Online Booking
History of the Site & Our Family

A new chapter, built on family values

Clarkwood MOT Ltd represents a new beginning for a site that has proudly served the Melksham community for many years.

The Legacy

Clarkwood Nurseries & Riverside

Dennis (Paul) Clark built a reputation for hard work, honesty and supporting local people through Clarkwood Nurseries and Riverside — earning the trust of generations of customers.

A Pause

Following the loss of Dennis (Paul) Clark

The previous MOT business closed, and the site returned to family ownership — ready to be relaunched with the same values Dennis (Paul) believed in throughout his life.

Autumn 2026

Clarkwood MOT Ltd reopens

Paul Clark and Christine Wood continue that legacy under new management — a fresh name and look, with the values remaining exactly the same.
